provider: CloudLab persistent remote dataset (10 TB, iSCSI)

free_tier.stated: up to 10 TB per persistent remote dataset; pool is 500 TB at Utah, 160 TB at Wisconsin, 40 TB at Clemson. Anything over 1 TB 'likely to require administrative approval'; long-term datasets are 'subject to per-project quotas for total size and might require interaction with CloudLab staff'

egress.terms: free; mounted as /dev/sdb via iSCSI on the experiment network, 50-200 MB/s

interface_detail: block device -> any filesystem -> any server you run on the node
tooling: portal 'Create Dataset' UI, RemoteBlockstore in RSpec, rwclone/readonly mapping for multi-node
chaining: persistent dataset + one node running S3/WebDAV + Cloudflare in front = 10 TB of genuinely durable-by-dint-of-not-being-wiped storage at $0
limits_note: 10 TB hard ceiling per dataset, so 20 TiB needs two datasets and two projects' worth of quota. >1 TB needs a human to approve. Simultaneous read-write sharing across nodes 'will almost certainly wind up with a corrupted dataset'. No off-site backup; RAID/ZFS on the storage server only.
reliability_note: Storage servers have RAID/ZFS but 'most clusters do not have off-site backup of user data'; a project expiry deletes the allocation.
